title: themeda thwaitesii
intro: Themeda thwaitesii, commonly known as Ceylon grass or Thwaites' grass, is a species of grass native to Sri Lanka. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Themeda thwaitesii has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, inflammation, and improving wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in Themeda thwaitesii include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
